summary: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway and model proxy.
overview: LiteLLM provides a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway for routing requests to multiple model providers through one API and admin console.
description:
LiteLLM is an open-source LLM gateway and proxy server. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, centralizes provider credentials, and adds features such as model routing, unified auth, spend tracking, and an admin UI.

This package deploys the official LiteLLM proxy with a bundled PostgreSQL database, following the upstream DB-backed Docker quickstart topology so the `/ui` admin console and model/key management features are available.

Typical use cases include unifying multiple LLM providers behind one endpoint, centralizing API access for internal tools, testing OpenAI-compatible clients against other model backends, and running a self-hosted AI gateway for teams.
